_hinweis: Englische Namen und Bestiariumstexte. Von Claude uebersetzt am 2026-10-12; zur Freigabe durch den Auftraggeber. Deutsche Originale bleiben die fuehrende Quelle (design.json, waffen.json, boni-und-laden.json, arenen.json, spielablauf.json). Eigennamen Knorz, Brassa, Fleck, Glimm und der Titel FABELBRUCH bleiben unuebersetzt.

AR01.name: Bell Court
AR01.hazard_desc: Two horizontal seams light up one after another.

AR02.name: Wax Mire
AR02.hazard_desc: Two round casting blisters appear and burst.

AR03.name: Mirror Grove
AR03.failed_wish: I want to see the whole truth.
AR03.hazard_desc: A vertical band of light passes as a single announced zone from left to right.

AR04.name: Root Chamber
AR04.failed_wish: No one shall go hungry again.
AR04.hazard_desc: Two small root circles press out of the earth.

AR05.name: Ink Archive
AR05.hazard_desc: Two rectangular lines are underlined one after another.

AR06.name: Seam Heath
AR06.hazard_desc: A taut seam is stretched in two separate strips.

AR07.name: Porcelain Break
AR07.hazard_desc: Two marked clay plates heave briefly.

AR08.name: Hour Marsh
AR08.failed_wish: I just need a little more time.
AR08.hazard_desc: Two sand circles strike with the same visible delay.

AR09.name: Ash Forge
AR09.hazard_desc: Two separate floor grates give off a brief rush of hot air.

AR10.name: Wishbreak
AR10.hazard_desc: Two small seal circles trigger one after another.

B01.name: The Hollow King
B01.telegraph: The clapper swings before every wave; the gap stays visible in the preview circle.
phases: Ring waves with a visible opening
Two maws alternate ring and cone
The crown falls; staggered ring waves

B02.name: Mother Drip
B02.telegraph: Flow channels are tinted before each pour.
phases: Slow pour zones
Wick arms hurl marked drops
The shell tips away; the new form pours stripes

B03.name: The False Sovereign
B03.telegraph: The true sovereign has an unbroken shadow; beam paths are fully drawn in advance.
phases: Aimed reflection beams
Two dull decoys mirror her pose
The central mirror breaks, opening safe gaps

B04.name: The Neverfull Stalk
B04.telegraph: Root cracks and suction streaks announce the direction.
phases: Root lines and a slow pull
Side pantries open
The empty belly narrows; two fast charges

B05.name: The Marginless
B05.telegraph: All lines appear first as dashed outlines; the walkway stays clear.
phases: Writes harmless preview lines that become attacks
Folds the attacks into right-angled lanes
Tears open into three connected zones

B06.name: Madam Mend
B06.telegraph: Needle tips mark the target; threads show the direction of tension.
phases: Large, clearly readable needle stitches
Pins herself to floor points with three visible threads
The hem comes loose and becomes a moving attack edge

B07.name: The Unbroken
B07.telegraph: A raised leg plus a closed ring; fragments only hurt after the landing mark.
phases: Wide stomp waves
Loses outer shells and changes silhouette
A small clay core attacks quickly with remaining plates

B08.name: The Thirteenth Hour
B08.telegraph: Large segment rings count down the lead time; repetitions stay announced.
phases: Delayed sand circles
Replays its last attack trail backwards
The glass tips; two separate sand streams

B09.name: The Cold Furnace
B09.telegraph: The bellows stretch before cones; floor tracks show the fire sequence.
phases: Breath cones and spark tracks
Visibly cools and draws in embers
Opens the furnace front; slow, wide fire lines

B10.name: The All-Wisher
B10.telegraph: The active material arm names the attack by its shape; never all three telegraphs at once.
phases: Three previously learned attack families in sequence
Arms detach and mark their own zones
The ring shatters; clearly timed combinations without new color logic

relic_flavor: A becalmed remnant of a wish grown too large.

relic_flavor_overrides.R025: Not quite round. It still lands right.
relic_flavor_overrides.R026: A small wish with surprisingly good bookkeeping.

U005.name: Light Feet
U005.note: More speed without changing dodge duration.

U006.name: Sharp Edge
U006.note: Increases the damage of all weapons.

U008.name: Long Arm
U008.note: Increases ranges; not area radii or shield size.

U009.name: Calm Ring
U009.note: Dodge cooldown never drops below 1.2 seconds.

U010.name: Repair Scrap
U010.note: Heals at the end of each wave.

U011.name: Good Find
U011.note: More wax shards from normal enemies.

U013.name: Favorable Chance
U013.note: +5 Luck. Improves the weighting of higher weapon tiers and rarer relics in the shop.

P03.name: Glimm's Thanks
P03.effect: First shop reroll each run is free; normal cost afterwards.
